title: Demucs
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: Temporal context
description: One channel with consecutive epochs concatenated in time.

nodes.title: Input preparation
description: Use an input length compatible with all encoder and decoder stages.

nodes.title: Convolutional encoder
description: Strided Conv1d / ReLU, then 1x1 convolution / GLU at each level.

nodes.title: Temporal bottleneck
description: Bidirectional LSTM across the bottleneck sequence; linear projection.

nodes.title: Mirrored decoder
description: Add matching encoder skips; Conv1d / GLU and transposed convolution.

nodes.title: Waveform prediction
description: Predict the artifact across the full temporal context.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

edges.label: Deployment input normalisation to Temporal context
Waveform prediction to Deployment artifact output

notes: Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain configuration-dependent.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
